changelog:
Initial release of codebytelens: a code intelligence toolbox inspired by Claude Code LSPTool, built with 100% open-source tools.

- Provides instant code searching (ripgrep), type checking (pyright), and AST parsing (tree-sitter) without requiring an LSP server.
- Supports definition/search, references, symbol listing, type checking, call graphs, and complexity reports for Python code.
- Simple command-line usage; just install dependencies and run analysis scripts.
summary: 代码智能分析工具箱。受 Claude Code LSPTool 设计模式启发，但使用 100% 开源工具：ripgrep (搜索)、pyright (Python 类型检查)、tree-sitter (AST 解析)。不需要 LSP 服务器，开箱即用。
